subject: Request: pause deletion window for support debugging (Acme Payments outage)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Request: pause deletion window for support debugging (Acme Payments outage)

Team —

Acme Payments (customer) just opened an incident: they see sporadic payment failures that correlate with short-lived inference requests we serve for their retry orchestration. On the support call a moment ago, their SRE asked if we can hold any auto-deletion of token-level debug traces that were generated between 2027-02-14T22:00Z and 2027-02-15T03:30Z. The logs look like they contain the KV caches and a handful of request/response pairs that would help us reproduce the retry behavior.

Ask: can we temporarily pause deletion for that narrow window and preserve artifacts for up to 72 hours so on-call can debug? If legal/compliance needs to sign-off or we need a minimized scope (paths, IDs), I can collect the specifics.

Why limited scope: we only need traces tied to Acme (customer_id: acme-678) and the associated request_ids below — I can provide exact IDs once we agree on the process. Acme is asking for urgency; they are OK with a short hold and a NDA addendum if required.

Attachments: [Attachment: support-log-snippet-20270215.txt (text/plain) — 18KB]
Related ticket: INF-9876 (internal)

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pause deletion window for support debugging (Acme Payments outage)

Priyom / team —

We can consider a time-boxed exception but need to cover a few items before sign-off:
1) Exact scope: list of S3 prefixes / dataset ids / request_ids that must be retained.
2) Retention length: propose maximum 72 hours; confirm if 48 hours would suffice.
3) Business justification: short summary from the customer and whether this includes PII or payment-critical data.
4) Approvals: Legal needs the exception request form signed (I attached the template). Security must validate access controls and deletion rollback steps.

Please also indicate whether we need a hard freeze (no deletions) or a soft copy to an internal forensic bucket. For speed, fill the attached PDF and reply; I can fast-track review if we keep the scope tight.

Naomi
Head of Legal & Privacy
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: deletion-exception-request-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 11:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pause deletion window for support debugging (Acme Payments outage)

Thanks Naomi — attaching a filled draft and proposing concrete limits to speed this.

Scope (proposed):
- Customer: Acme Payments (customer_id: acme-678)
- Time window: 2027-02-14T22:00:00Z through 2027-02-15T03:30:00Z
- Objects: inference-traces/acme-678/2027/02/14/22-00-00_to_03-30-00/* (approx 42 files, ~120MB)
- Request IDs (sample): r_20270214_2312_az12, r_20270214_2348_jk09, r_20270215_0110_lm33 (I will send the full list to security-only thread)
- Proposed hold: 72 hours (auto-delete after 2027-02-18T03:30:00Z)
- Exposure: traces include obfuscated user identifiers and request/response payloads; no full cardholder data is stored by Redwood.

Attached: filled_deletion_exception_draft.pdf (redwood draft) — please review and let me know if security/legal need more info. If approved, I'll notify Acme and our on-call to proceed with forensic capture.

Priyom
[Attachment: filled_deletion_exception_draft.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 12:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pause deletion window for support debugging (Acme Payments outage)

I reviewed the proposed scope and footprint. Security is comfortable with a 72-hour preservation if we enforce strict access controls and narrow the object set to the S3 prefix listed. Conditions:
- Create a read-only forensic bucket (access: security-team, dev-oncall, legal-review) and copy the files there within the hour. Do not change the production lifecycle policy; operate by copying and tagging.
- Audit: enable object-level access logs for that bucket and retain logs for 90 days.
- No sharing outside of the approved list without formal escalation.
- Auto-delete job scheduled for 2027-02-18T03:30:00Z; add a 1-hour grace buffer for manual revoke if we need an extension.

I will add an approval note in INF-9876 and attach the technical steps. Once Naomi confirms legal sign-off on the exception form, security will execute the copy and tagging.

—Karthik
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 15:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pause deletion window for support debugging (Acme Payments outage)

All —

Naomi: legal sign-off confirmed (see attached signed page). We limited the scope as requested; Acme agreed to the 72-hour hold.
Karthik: security runbook executed and forensic bucket created; access logs enabled.
Priyom: please notify Acme that we've preserved the requested traces and will auto-delete on 2027-02-18T03:30:00Z unless an extension is requested. Include the support-ticket INF-9876 in your message.

Thanks team for the quick turnaround — good example of a targeted, time-boxed exception.

Monica
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: signed_exception_page.pdf (application/pdf)]
